title: things i never thought id be sharing with the internet…

segments.text: I measure my vagina daily. [music] I insert this swab into my vagina to collect the sample, and then I put the swab into this tube and I ship [music] it to the lab. This is all part of a 2.6 million dollar female health experiment, and my vagina is just one part of that.

This test checks for 10,000 bacteria, four STIs, and [music] pH balance. The swab collects shed vaginal cells in mucus and the bacteria living in it. That swab then goes into a tube with a preservation buffer which locks the DNA in place. Then the lab looks at the genetics of the microbes. [music] So instead of growing bacteria in a dish or running a targeted test for a few known microbes, the lab [music] reads the actual DNA present in the sample. Once the results come in, my 12-person medical team reviews it alongside [music] 1,900 other biomarkers. This will be the most quantified menstrual cycle ever. I'm sharing all the results
here, the good and the bad. So if you want to find out what happens, follow along.
